hints.title: Span of Permutation Triplets
hints.text: For an array containing numbers up to n, any combination of three elements can span all bit patterns within the most significant bit range.

hints.title: Power of Two Upper Bound
hints.text: For n >= 3, all bit combinations below the smallest power of two strictly greater than n are achievable.

hints.title: Small Array Base Cases
hints.text: For n < 3, the number of distinct results equals n.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Bitwise shift calculates the next power of two in logarithmic time.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Brute force triplet evaluation takes cubic time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Constant space mathematical bit logic replaces combinatorial iteration.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Identify the bitwise span property of complete permutation prefixes.
